rms — ONED signal op

• 数据种类:signal → measurement

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.rms(x, frame=None, hop=None)(要直接调用实现,import dsp; dsp.rms(x, frame=None, hop=None);从台账取用则 ops1d.get("rms"))

用法

> 该算子的说明尚无译文,以下照原文给出。

RMS level. Scalar for the whole signal, or a framewise array when *frame*

is given (a vibration/energy envelope over time).
